eligibility_note: Dev verdict on a synthetic fixture; it cannot set a default. The parent wave routes facts.candidate_fusion and the supersession threshold.

threshold_pick.rule: lowest correction miss rate with false supersession <= 1% of probes and preserved distinct claims >= 99.5% (rrf_free arm); balanced = argmin(correction miss + coexisting false supersession)
